betterquesting:10.desc:8:
MV begins with a materials problem: the MV machine hull wants aluminium, and so does every MV machine part after it. The tutorial's advice stands — MV electrolyzer for aluminium, MV extruder for cheaper parts, MV miner for your weekends.

Voltage law gets stricter, not softer: feeding MV to an LV machine explodes it; MV over LV cable melts the cable and burns the crater wider. Higher-tier machines also run lower-tier recipes faster — safely, if you wire it safely.

Plan aluminium stock like ammunition. You will need magazines of it.
